options.text: 25 days

options.why: 25 days is how long U stays as an adult. It tells us nothing about the time before U becomes an adult.

options.text: 40 days

options.why: 40 days is the time for the whole life cycle. To become an adult, U does not need to go through the adult stage itself.

title: Organism V
stem:
The table shows the number of days organism V spends at each stage of its life cycle.

Which statement is true about organism V?

options.text: V is a grasshopper, because it has a nymph stage.
options.pick: Grasshoppers have nymphs, and the table has a nymph stage.
options.why: The table does not name the animal. Cockroaches also have a nymph stage. We can only say V has a nymph stage, not which animal it is.

options.text: V takes 19 days from the time the egg is laid to become an adult.
options.pick: Add the stages before the adult stage: egg 7 days + nymph 12 days = 19 days.
options.why: Correct: 7 + 12 = 19 days.

options.text: V takes 12 days to change from an egg to an adult.
options.pick: The Nymph row is the stage just before Adult, so its number seems to be the time.
options.why: 12 days is only the nymph stage. The egg stage (7 days) comes before it.

options.text: V takes 37 days to become an adult.
options.pick: Add all the numbers: 7 + 12 + 18 = 37.
options.why: 37 days is the whole life cycle. V becomes an adult after 7 + 12 = 19 days.

options.text: After 5 days
options.pick: 5 is a small number, so it seems to be an early stage.
options.why: The egg stage lasts 6 days, so after 5 days W is still an egg.

options.text: After 12 days
options.pick: The Pupa bar is 12 days high, so 12 days must be when it is a pupa.
options.why: 12 is how long the pupa stage lasts, not when it happens. W is an egg for 6 days and a larva for the next 8 days (day 6 to day 14), so after 12 days it is a larva.

options.text: After 20 days
options.pick: Add the earlier stages to find where the pupa stage starts: 6 + 8 = 14 days. It lasts 12 days, so it ends after 26 days. 20 days is between.
options.why: Correct: the pupa stage runs from day 14 to day 26, and 20 is inside it.

options.text: After 30 days
options.pick: 30 is a bigger number, so it seems to be a later stage such as the pupa.
options.why: The pupa stage ends after 26 days. After 30 days W is an adult.

title: Organism B

options.pick: Butterflies have a pupa stage, and so does B.
options.why: Moths, beetles and mosquitoes also have a pupa stage. The table does not name the animal, so we cannot say B is a butterfly.

options.text: B starts its pupa stage 18 days after the egg is laid.
options.pick: The stages before the pupa are the egg and the larva. 8 + 10 = 18.
options.why: Correct: the pupa stage starts after 8 + 10 = 18 days.

options.text: B starts its pupa stage 10 days after the egg is laid.
options.pick: The Larva row is just before the Pupa row, so its 10 days seem to be the time.
options.why: 10 days is only the larva stage. The egg stage (8 days) comes before it.

options.text: B starts its pupa stage 36 days after the egg is laid.
options.pick: Add all the numbers: 8 + 10 + 6 + 12 = 36.
options.why: 36 days is the whole life cycle. The pupa stage starts after only the egg and larva stages: 18 days.

options.text: The young stage of C looks like a small adult, so it is a nymph.
options.pick: Young animals that look like small adults are often nymphs.
options.why: The graph only says Young. A chicken also has a young stage that looks like a small adult. We cannot tell from the graph.

options.text: C is at its young stage on the third day.
options.pick: Three is a small number, so it seems to be an early stage.
options.why: The egg stage lasts 5 days, so on the third day C is still an egg.

options.text: C is still young on the tenth day.
options.pick: Add the stages: egg 5 days, then young for 10 more days, so young lasts from day 5 to day 15. Day 10 is inside it.
options.why: Correct: C is young from day 5 to day 15.

options.text: C is an adult on the twelfth day.
options.pick: 12 is near the top of the Young bar (10) and the Adult bar (15), so it seems to be an adult.
options.why: C only becomes an adult after 5 + 10 = 15 days. On the twelfth day it is still young.
